directions: Use a carving fork to stab the pork all over, then coat it thoroughly with 1½ tablespoons of Hawaiian sea salt and 1 tablespoon of liquid smoke. Transfer the seasoned pork into the slow cooker.
Cover the pot and cook on the low setting for 16 to 20 hours, giving the meat one turn halfway through the process.
Take the pork out of the slow cooker and shred it with two forks, adding any leftover drippings to keep the shreds moist.
title: Kalua Pig in a Slow Cooker
